outputs.discrepancies: The three enrichment plots shown (HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION, HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING, HALLMARK_IL2_STAT5_SIGNALING) have the correct shape and match the GSEA output curves in the deposited source data (same 'T11b high vs low LUSC' GSEA run), confirming the correct gene sets are depicted. However, the NES (and for one plot, FDR) values printed on the panel do not match the values reported in the corresponding source-data GSEA report (gsea_report_for_na_pos...tsv) for the same run: EMT panel shows NES=3.768 vs source NES=3.8383; IL6/JAK/STAT3 panel shows NES=2.74 vs source NES=2.6949; IL2/STAT5 panel shows NES=2.03, FDR=0.0038 vs source NES=2.0784, FDR=0.00299. The nominal p-values (p=0.0) do match the source data for all three.
